tool_args.rationale: The previously fitted spatio-temporal ODE failed fresh confirmation, but the supplied signatures and varied gradient/input observations still support testing the simpler stationary inland-hub saturation law with a signed square-root branch. Its parameters are numerically fitted, and confirmation will determine whether this alternative meets tolerance.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The eight-row dataset already includes the paid trajectory batch; the coupled ODE has been tested and refuted.
Fresh confirmation RMSE 0.321245 greatly exceeds tolerance 0.045, so repeating that stationary mechanism is not justified.
The available rows include gradients above 1.4, but evidence does not specifically identify an avalanche threshold; first test the simpler supported siphon branch.
Only one stationary mechanism has been refuted; observations do not show high-frequency chaotic oscillations or refutation of all smooth alternatives.
